title: TLS certificate verification disabled in HTTP client via InsecureSkipVerify
detail: src/aurora/aurora-compute/api/server.go:L17 sets InsecureSkipVerify: true in the tls.Config returned by newClient(); this disables all server certificate validation, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks against every connection made with this client. The scanner rule fired as 'missing-ssl-minversion' but the actual defect is CWE-295 (certificate validation absent, not merely weak).

title: Command injection via fmt.Sprintf interpolation into exec.Command(sh,-c,...)
detail: src/aurora/aurora-compute/api/server.go:L24 builds a shell command string using fmt.Sprintf("virsh console %s", instance) and passes it to exec.Command("sh", "-c", ...) without sanitizing instance; shell metacharacters in instance cause the shell to execute additional commands.
